property_summary: For any caller other than DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT, setL1BlockValues always reverts; for a call from DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT, the reference sets batcherHash to the input while the buggy version always reverts, thus for at least one input from DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT the batcherHash remains unchanged in the buggy version and matches the input in the reference.

When the depositor calls setL1BlockValues, the update succeeds exactly when the call does not revert; the reference always updates batcherHash for the depositor, while the mutant always reverts, so for the depositor the reference updates batcherHash and the mutant leaves it unchanged.

For any call from the depositor, if setL1BlockValues does not revert, then batcherHash must equal the supplied batcherHash input; the buggy version always reverts for the depositor, so it can never satisfy this implication.
